title: Figure 3: Metallic glass microspring and blow-molded thin-walled bottle
description: Two photographs captioned "Figure 3. Examples of Processing of Metallic Glasses." Panel (a) shows a spiral microspring produced by lithography with a 200 µm scale bar; panel (b) shows a thin-walled metallic glass bottle produced by blow molding with a 5 cm scale bar. Images are credited to Professor Jan Schroers (Yale University); the page is part of the 'Casting and Molding' section of a metallic glasses report.
